openIssues.label: Desktop loses natural in-progress game on reload
openIssues.reproduction: Start > advance > roll 6 to Bank > deposit 6M > reload. Setup returns with no resume or import.
openIssues.source: src/App.tsx holds game only in React state; Desktop Setup has no restore/import route.
openIssues.backup: JSON can be downloaded before leaving; importing it is available on Mobile, not Desktop.

limitations: WebKit Windows is not native Safari/iOS. Physical devices unverified.
Viewport resize approximates rotation/virtual keyboard; CSS zoom is not native browser zoom.
Firefox/WebKit full games cover Mobile; Desktop there is covered through first transaction and viewport matrix.
Initial Desktop harness selector failures remain documented, then rerun successfully.
One bounded legal-engine seed planning pass is not UI evidence; selected seed was played independently. Stocks fixture is a replay prefix, not a complete new UI game.
hashing: Source normalized UTF8 LF; raw-byte artifact SHA256. Manifest excludes itself. Archived source checks use the exact candidate manifest only.
